name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's motorsport journey began with tinkering on Lada engines in his father's garage. His fascination with engineering led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, where he specialized in aerodynamics. After university, he joined a small racing outfit as a junior engineer, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp eye for detail and relentless work ethic. He spent several years honing his skills in various technical roles before transitioning to management, recognizing his ability to motivate and lead teams.

As a team principal, Zoltán is known for his demanding but fair approach. He believes in setting high expectations and providing his team with the resources they need to succeed. He is a firm believer in data-driven decision-making and constantly seeks innovative solutions to improve performance. His analytical mind and passion for motorsport make him a force to be reckoned with in the paddock. He is particularly known for his strategic race management and ability to extract maximum performance from his drivers.

What distinguishes Zoltán is his hands-on approach. He doesn't just sit in the office; he's often found in the garage, working alongside the engineers and mechanics, ensuring everyone is on the same page and pushing for excellence. He is very open to new ideas and suggestions, and enjoys working with innovative and creative individuals.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze, Zoltán always appears to be deep in thought.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when under pressure.
Insists on having a strong espresso before every race.
